ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels and 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields on both lobes. Black pigmentation is mapped to the entire perimeter including leading edges, trailing edges, and the peduncle attachment area. Sparse black focal spots are distributed across the white interior, with higher density on the medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks are localized at the distal ends of both lobes, with smaller amplitude variations occurring closer to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning into a slightly convex arc towards the lateral tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity (black) circular clusters detected on the high-intensity (white) field of the left lobe, concentrated in the lower-central quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four parallel, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the left lobe, extending from the mid-section toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the left lobe and irregular notch scarring where the lobes meet the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'comma-shaped' dark pigment cluster located in the upper-medial region of the right lobe.
